    About this data

    Sources

    • Trips: Bluebikes system data, monthly trip history files, January 2025 through October 2026.
    • Stations: Bluebikes station list, last updated August 21, 2026. Station locations on the map are the median point where classic bikes were docked at each station.
    • Basemap: MassGIS town boundaries, open space (publicly accessible parcels over about 7 acres), major ponds and rivers and MBTA rapid transit lines; MassDOT road inventory. Neighborhood streets appear when you zoom in.

    Which trips are included

    • Every trip that started or ended at the Newton Highlands T station (station ID N32010): 2,616 trips to or from another station, plus round trips.
    • The station has no trips before March 5, 2025, or from August 27 to September 28, 2025, most likely because it was out of service. Trips per month count only the 20 months the station was operating, and September 2025 is a partial month.
    • Bluebikes removes trips taken by its staff while servicing the system and trips shorter than 60 seconds before publishing the data.
    • Left out: 12 trips with no station recorded at the other end, usually e-bikes left outside a dock.
    • Stations are listed under their current names. Some stations were renamed or moved during the period; for example, Union St at Herrick Rd appears as "Langley Lot" in March and April 2025.

    How to read the numbers

    • Riders: Bluebikes data doesn't say who is riding. Unlike at Boston College T, ridership here peaks in summer: about 208 trips a month in June through August, against about 98 a month the rest of the year.
    • Members and casual riders: members have an annual or monthly membership; casual riders used a single-trip or day pass.
    • Seasons: fall is September–November, winter December–February, spring March–May and summer June–August. Months with service in this data: . Trips per month divides by those counts. Line thickness uses total trips, and the seasons cover 3 to 6 months each, so compare them with that in mind.
    • Distances are straight-line miles from the Newton Highlands T station, not the route ridden. Bluebikes data doesn't record routes.
    • Round trips (the dashed ring) left from and returned to Newton Highlands T. About half were taken by casual riders, and the median trip lasted about 28 minutes. Trips under 5 minutes are counted separately because they are likely bike swaps or re-docks. Round trips are hidden when a direction is picked, because they count as both.
    • Trip length: medians leave out trips longer than 24 hours, which are likely bikes that weren't docked properly. Those trips are still counted everywhere else.
    • E-bikes: riders can only take the kind of bike that's docked when they arrive, so e-bike shares partly reflect how many e-bikes Bluebikes had in service, not only what riders prefer.

    Data through October 31, 2026. Map built with Leaflet.
